named_question_A01_S03_P1.authorized_source: activity_01_luz_y_plantines/02_rubric.docx defines FOUR named criteria: 'Afirmación y alcance', 'Uso de evidencia', 'Variables y medidas', 'Limitación'. The 'Variables y medidas' descriptors are: logrado='Distingue la cantidad de luz de al menos una medida de crecimiento'; no sustentado='No distingue qué se cambió de qué se observó'.
rationale: The property scores the rubric criterion 'Variables y medidas' (independent/dependent variable assignment). The route asks the model about claim-to-evidence linkage. These are different rubric criteria in the SAME authorized rubric, which explicitly states criteria 'deben leerse de forma relacionada, pero no intercambiable'.
The model never sees the string 'Variables y medidas', the property, or the rubric. Per the P06 contract its support_status is a judgement about model_visible_definition.construct only.

Decisive internal contradiction: the sibling route P06-A01-S03-R02 has the SAME family, SAME cognitive_operation and SAME observable, differing only in the section suffix ('Desarrollo' vs 'encabezado'), and is bound to A01-S03-P2 which ratifies PARTIAL, no INSUFFICIENT for 'Uso de evidencia' on the same submission. A model correctly judging claim-to-evidence linkage on submission_03 is therefore ratified as PARTIAL by one property and INSUFFICIENT by the other, for the same construct.
The evidence sets overlap (ev_f5d07c6e822cb5f935a0 and ev_c579dd16629f81c516ab appear in both routes), so evidence selection does not disambiguate them either.
named_question_A01_S03_P1.consequence: A candidate's support_status on P06-A01-S03-R01 cannot be validly scored against A01-S03-P1. This is a fixture defect, not a model defect.

activity_wide_properties.description: La actividad ofrece los cuatro estados de P06 en distintas entregas: SUFFICIENT (01, 02), PARTIAL (03 evidencia, 04 limitación), INSUFFICIENT (03 variables, 04 evidencia) y UNCERTAIN (06, párrafo final donde el estudiante declara no saber qué grupo es cuál).

La actividad cubre los cuatro estados de P06 con evidencia ejecutable: SUFFICIENT (01), PARTIAL con defecto localizado (02), INSUFFICIENT múltiple (03, 05, 06) y NO VERIFICABLE por artefacto ausente (04), que funciona como el caso UNCERTAIN estructural.
La tabla autorizada y las dos submissions corregidas son consistentes en el apoyo por banda: 15, 8 y 3; el total es 26.
LENGTH_COMPLIANCE es NOT_APPLICABLE como propiedad semántica hard: los rangos de postmortem y ADR son orientación de formato y la pauta valora evidencia, razonamiento y coherencia entre artefactos.

question_1_can_the_adjudicator_know_what.evidence: route_or_opportunity_id carries only the opaque fixture id string (e.g. 'P06-A01-S03-R01'). model_visible_definition (construct / focus / observable / cognitive_operation / evidence_requirement) is NEVER projected into the packet. The adjudicator sees the ratified property ('INSUFFICIENT para Variables y medidas') and the canonical output, and must assume the model was asked about that criterion. PART A shows it was asked about 'Relación entre afirmación y evidencia: encabezado' instead.
question_1_can_the_adjudicator_know_what.consequence: Every construct-misalignment defect found in PART A is structurally invisible at the adjudication surface.

question_2_can_the_adjudicator_know_whic.evidence: The packet carries no authority map. The only ownership-flavoured string reachable from the packet is inside candidate_output itself: EvidenceVariantMatch.justification = 'Relaciones categóricas P06 materializadas por el servidor.' That string is server-authored prose about alias materialization and does NOT describe ownership of support_status, which is a verbatim copy of the provider draft (evidence_mapping.py:418).
question_2_can_the_adjudicator_know_whic.consequence: The packet actively invites the inference that the P06 semantic decision is server-owned. That inference is false.

question_3_can_the_adjudicator_know_whic.evidence: evidence_fit, mapping_confidence, variant-level support_status and the mapping_summary counts are all deterministic projections of the model-owned support_status (evidence_mapping.py:413, 451, 452-456, 460, 464-466). Nothing in the packet distinguishes them from independent server judgements, so an adjudicator may either double-count them as corroboration or discount the model decision as derived.

findings.detail: The note attributes UNCERTAIN to '(06, párrafo final donde el estudiante declara no saber qué grupo es cuál)'. submission_06 has NO .txt artifact at all (it is submissions/submission_06.pdf), so it has no 'párrafo final' of that kind. The described text is verbatim submission_01.txt: 'De la tabla recuerdo que había dos condiciones ... No sé si A era doce horas o cuatro horas.' The ratified case-level property A01-S01-P3 (VALID/HIGH/REQUIRED) states exactly that: 'UNCERTAIN bien fundado: el párrafo final ...'. The UNCERTAIN case is submission_01, not submission_06.

The same note lists 'SUFFICIENT (01, 02)'. submission_01's only ratified P06 property (A01-S01-P3, VALID, HIGH) is UNCERTAIN. The note therefore asserts both SUFFICIENT and UNCERTAIN for submission_01.

Declared source_refs = ['submissions/submission_01.txt#párrafo final'] only. That ref does support the UNCERTAIN claim - and in doing so confirms the '(06...)' label is the error, not the ref. It supports none of the SUFFICIENT/PARTIAL/INSUFFICIENT claims, which concern submissions 02, 03 and 04.

'INSUFFICIENT (... 04 evidencia)' has no ratified backing: the only P06 property on submission_04 is A01-S04-P2, which is about 'Limitación', is kind=DEFENSIBLE_ALTERNATIVE and oracle_state=ORACLE_SUSPECT. No A01-S04 property scores 'Uso de evidencia'.

'PARTIAL (... 04 limitación)' asserts PARTIAL, but A01-S04-P2 is explicitly ratified ORACLE_SUSPECT and admits INSUFFICIENT or PARTIAL as equally defensible. The coverage note hardens a deliberately unsettled case.

property_bindings.json binds A01-ACT-P5 with binding_scope=ACTIVITY_WIDE to fixture P06-A01-S01-R01 with additional_case_ids=[] - a SINGLE case. An activity-wide claim spanning submissions 01,02,03,04,06 is adjudicated from one route over submission_01's final paragraph. No candidate output on that one route can demonstrate or refute four-state activity coverage. Contrast A04-ACT-P5 (10 additional cases, ACTIVITY_STAGE_EXHAUSTIVE) and A06-ACT-FINAL-P5 (5 additional cases).

p06_routes.json route P06-A01-S01-R01 declares oracle_binding_metadata.property_ids = ['A01-S01-P3'] and does NOT list A01-ACT-P5, while property_bindings.json does bind it. The two frozen fixtures disagree about what this route is scored on. Same asymmetry holds for P06-A04-S01-R01 and P06-A06-S01-R01.

A01-ACT-P5.recommended_disposition: CONTEXTUAL_NON_GATE and ORACLE_SUSPECT. It is already kind=CONTEXTUAL_NOTE; the binding must not make it candidate-scoreable. Its declared oracle_state VALID is not sustainable given the submission-attribution error.
